answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the saffron. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
